_readme: The same yard at 16px, so the world-scale gates have two sizes to compare.
It exists because the shipped game is no longer 16px: every demo map draws at lpc32 now, so
a suite that wanted a narrow world had nowhere to get one. Kept beside its wide twin and
identical in every other respect - same shape, same spawn, same tiles - because the one
thing being measured is the size, and a second difference would muddy it.
